listings.subtitle: Choose Your Preferred Method to Display Events
listings.subtitleSingle: Learn How to Display Events in List, Grid & More Layouts
listings.desc: Select an option below to learn how to display events in list, grid, carousel and more layouts.
listings.jobSub: Create a better-looking events listing page.

elementor.label: Elementor Widget
elementor.description: Follow the steps below to create event lists, grids, carousels and more layouts with Elementor widgets.
elementor.installText: First, install this addon to display events in list, grid and more layouts with Elementor.
steps: Add new or edit a page with Elementor where you want to display events.
Search for Events Widget in Elementor and drag it onto your page.
Choose a layout and customize the display and style settings.
Publish or update the page to view events in your selected layout and style.
stepsPro: Add new or edit a page with Elementor where you want to display events.
Search for Events Loop Widget in Elementor and drag it onto your page.
Choose a layout, select a loop item template and customize the style settings.
Publish or update the page to view events in your selected layout and style.

divi.label: Divi Module
divi.description: Show events in list, grid, carousel and more layouts with drag-and-drop Events Calendar modules for Divi.
divi.installText: Use native Divi modules to display events in list, grid and more layouts.
steps: Open or create a page with Divi Builder where you want to show events.
Find Events Layout in the Divi modules list and insert it on the page.
Select your preferred layout and adjust the module display and design options.
Save or publish the page to see your events in the chosen layout.

bricks.label: Bricks Element
bricks.description: Show events inside Bricks Builder using the Events element from Shortcodes & Blocks.
steps: Add new or edit a page in Bricks Builder to display events.
Search for Events Widget in Bricks Builder and add it to your page.
Choose a layout and customize the display and style settings.
Publish or update the page to view your events in the selected layout.

wpbakery.label: WPBakery Element
wpbakery.description: Add the Events Calendar shortcode generator module inside WPBakery Page Builder and publish your listing.
steps: Edit a page with WPBakery Page Builder.
Add the Events Calendar Shortcode element.
Configure the layout and publish.

shortcode.label: Shortcode
shortcode.description: Use a shortcode on any page or post to display events in list, grid and other layouts.
steps: Add new or edit the page where you want to display your events.
Search Events Shortcodes in the Block Editor or paste [events-calendar-templates] shortcode.
Choose layout and styles in the Block Editor, or add attributes manually to your shortcode.
Publish or update the page to view your event listing in the selected layout.
stepsClassic: Open or create a page in the Classic Editor where you want to display events.
Click the Events Shortcodes button, configure the options and insert the shortcode.
You can also paste [events-calendar-templates] shortcode manually and customize its attributes.
Publish or update the page to view your events in the selected layout and style.

block.label: Events Block
block.description: Add the Events block in the WordPress editor and pick a layout — grid, list, carousel and more.
steps: Add new or edit a page in the Block Editor to display events.
Search for Events Block in the Block Editor and add it to your page.
Choose a layout and customize the display and style settings.
Publish or update the page to view your events in the selected layout.

singlePage.subtitle: Choose How to Customize Your Single Event Page
singlePage.subtitleSingle: Improve Your Single Event Page Design
singlePage.desc: Select an option below to learn how to design and customize your single event page template.
singlePage.jobSub: Custom templates for single event pages.

elementorTpl.label: Elementor Templates
elementorTpl.description: Learn how to design and customize single event page templates using Elementor template builder.
elementorTpl.installText: Install this addon to design and customize single event page templates with Elementor.
steps: Go to Events Addons → Event Page Templates and add a new template or edit an existing one.
Choose what you want to customize, such as single event pages or event category archive pages.
Choose a pre-made template, set the display conditions and save or publish it.
Once applied to single event pages, edit the template in Elementor to customize it further.

diviTpl.label: Divi Templates
diviTpl.description: Learn how to design and customize single event page templates using Divi builder.
diviTpl.installText: You must install this addon to design or customize single event page templates with Divi.
steps: Make sure you are using Divi 5, as single event page customization is supported in Divi 5.
Go to Divi → Theme Builder and here you will find some single event page templates.
Edit a template settings and select Use on → Events to apply it to single event pages.
Edit the template’s custom body in Divi Builder to customize its layout and styles as needed.

static.label: Static Templates
static.description: Learn how to design and customize your single event page using beautiful ready-made templates in just a few clicks.
steps: Go to Events Addons → Event Page Templates and add new or edit a template.
Choose a pre-made template layout for your single event page.
Set display conditions, colors and other style options.
Save and publish the template to apply the new event page design.
